title: Oven Roasted German Chicken Stew
description: A hearty German chicken stew featuring chilli and tadka, perfect for a post-workout meal, cooked to perfection in a copper pot. This dish is high in protein and has a nice balance of salty and springy flavors.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large copper pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the sliced chilli peppers, chopped carrots, and chopped potatoes, and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together the chicken broth, tadka spice blend, salt, and black pepper, and pour the mixture over the chicken and vegetables.
Cover the copper pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the stew in the oven for 30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
